trans-unit.source: The GitHub job summary file is {0} bytes and appending this report section would exceed the {1}-byte limit GitHub enforces per step. GitHub discards an oversized job summary in full rather than truncating it, so appending would have lost every section, including those other test projects already wrote. This section was skipped to keep the rest of the summary intact. This usually means many test projects, or other tools, are writing to the same job summary; see the workflow log or the test report for these results.
